Container.Name: NullFeed
Container.Overview: NullFeed is a self-hosted YouTube media center: subscribe to channels, automatically download new uploads with yt-dlp, and stream them ad-free to the iOS app and the native Apple TV app. This single all-in-one image runs the API, the background downloader/poller (Celery + Redis), and the database internally — no extra containers required. New uploads are discovered via adaptive RSS polling (and optional WebSub for near-real-time), and new-episode push notifications are relayed through a shared push gateway, so no Apple push key of your own is needed. Set ANTHROPIC_API_KEY to enable the AI "Discover" recommendations.
Container.Description: Self-hosted YouTube media center — downloads subscribed channels and streams them ad-free to the NullFeed iOS & Apple TV apps. All-in-one image (API + downloader + Redis + DB).

Config.Name: WebUI / API Port
Config.Description: HTTP port for the API and the apps to connect to.

Config.Name: Media library
Config.Description: Downloaded video files (content) — the ONLY volume that should leave appdata. Point this at your media/content share.

Config.Name: App config
Config.Description: App config + persisted secrets (stream-ticket secret, push gateway key, WebSub secret). appdata.

Config.Name: Database
Config.Description: SQLite library index (channels, videos, profiles, sessions). App data, like Sonarr/Radarr's /config — appdata.

Config.Name: Thumbnails
Config.Description: Cached video/channel thumbnail images (metadata, not content) — appdata.

Config.Name: Anthropic API Key
Config.Description: Optional. Enables the AI 'Discover' recommendations tab. Leave blank to disable that feature.

Config.Name: Media Quality
Config.Description: Default download quality: 720p | 1080p | 4k | best.

Config.Name: Download Concurrency
Config.Description: Maximum simultaneous yt-dlp downloads.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID that owns the downloaded files (Unraid default is 99 = nobody).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID that owns the downloaded files (Unraid default is 100 = users).

Config.Name: Scheduler tick (minutes)
Config.Description: How often the poller wakes to check which channels are due. Keep ≤ the poll floor below.

Config.Name: Poll interval floor (minutes)
Config.Description: Fastest per-channel polling interval (used for active channels).

Config.Name: Poll interval cap (minutes)
Config.Description: Slowest per-channel polling interval (used for quiet channels).

Config.Name: Poll backoff factor
Config.Description: How quickly a quiet channel's interval grows toward the cap.

Config.Name: Trust proxy headers
Config.Description: Set true ONLY when behind a single trusted reverse proxy that sets X-Forwarded-For (used for PIN rate-limiting). Leave false for direct access.

Config.Name: Stream ticket secret
Config.Description: Optional HMAC secret for short-lived stream/WebSocket tickets. Leave blank to auto-generate and persist under /data/config (fine for single-host). Set explicitly only for multi-host or to rotate tickets.

Config.Name: Push gateway URL
Config.Description: Relays new-episode push notifications (auto-enrolls; no Apple key needed). Leave default to use the public gateway, set BLANK to disable push, or point at your own gateway.

Config.Name: Push API key (optional)
Config.Description: Pin an explicit gateway tenant key instead of auto-enrolling. Leave blank to auto-enroll.

Config.Name: Push enroll token (optional)
Config.Description: Only needed if the gateway uses 'gated' enrollment. Leave blank for the public gateway.

Config.Name: WebSub callback URL (optional)
Config.Description: Optional near-real-time new-upload push from YouTube. Set to a PUBLIC https URL that routes to /api/websub/callback (e.g. https://nullfeed.example.com/api/websub/callback). Leave blank to rely on RSS polling.

Config.Name: WebSub hub URL
Config.Description: PubSubHubbub hub (Google's public hub by default). Only used when a WebSub callback URL is set.

Config.Name: WebSub lease (seconds)
Config.Description: Subscription lease to request/renew (default 5 days). Only used when WebSub is enabled.
